subject: Vendor credentialing and invoice field specs for Acme Clinical PO flow
messages:
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@acmeclinical.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Procurements AP <procurements@acmeclinical.com>
Date: 2028-09-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: New vendor: Redwood Inference - onboarding & PO requirements

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

We're ready to add Redwood Inference as a supplier in Acme Clinical's AP system. Please find our vendor onboarding packet attached. A few priority items our AP team needs confirmed so we can issue POs and process your invoices without delays: 

- Mandatory PO number on the first line of invoice and in the invoice header (no buried PO in the body)
- Invoice must include remit-to (bank) details and the vendor legal name exactly as registered
- VAT handling: we need your VAT registration certificate if invoicing EU entities; otherwise we will apply reverse-charge where appropriate (we will flag the invoice)
- Preferred format: PDF invoice attached to the AP portal submission; EDI (Peppol) is a plus but not required for initial setup
- Payment terms: Our standard is Net45 unless otherwise agreed; please confirm your preferred terms and early-pay options

Can you please return: 1) completed onboarding packet, 2) your VAT cert or tax ID, and 3) an example invoice that meets our PO field requirements? Once received, it typically takes 48-72 hours to create your vendor record and issue a vendor ID.

Thanks — looping in Procurements for visibility.

—Oliver
Oliver Hayes
Head of Accounts Payable, Acme Clinical
attachments: acme_vendor_onboarding_packet.xlsx (excel)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@acmeclinical.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-09-01T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: New vendor: Redwood Inference - onboarding & PO requirements

Hi Oliver — thanks for the packet and the clear checklist. Attaching the completed onboarding form and our VAT registration PDF. I've also attached a sample invoice exported from our billing system that includes the PO field in the header. Quick answers up front:

- Remit details: included on the sample invoice (bank name, IBAN, SWIFT) and in the onboarding form.
- Legal name: "Redwood Inference, Inc." — please use exactly that when creating the vendor record.
- Payment terms: Net45 is fine for initial onboarding. We'll review early-pay options (we have a 1% for Net15 program) once the account is created.

@Neha — can you confirm the VAT note language we should place on invoices for EU customers to make reverse-charge clear? Also flag any additional fields Acme needs beyond PO and remit.

Next steps proposed:
1) Acme confirms receipt and creates vendor record.
2) Acme returns vendor ID and preferred invoice submission method (portal upload vs. email vs. Peppol).
3) Redwood submits first invoice with PO reference and we confirm successful validation.

Attaching: redwood-vat-certificate.pdf, redwood-invoice-sample.xlsx, redwood-onboarding-completed.xlsx

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-vat-certificate.pdf (pdf), redwood-invoice-sample.xlsx (excel), redwood-onboarding-completed.xlsx (excel)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>, Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@acmeclinical.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-09-02T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: New vendor: Redwood Inference - onboarding & PO requirements

Hi all — adding a few technical invoice requirements from our side so Acme's AP team can validate automatically: 

- Invoice fields we populate (please ensure your portal mapping includes these): InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate (ISO yyyy-mm-dd), SupplierLegalName, SupplierVAT, BuyerPO, Currency, LineItemDescription, LineItemQty, LineItemUnitPrice, LineItemTax, LineTotal, InvoiceTotal, RemitBankName, RemitIBAN, RemitSWIFT.
- For EU customers where reverse-charge applies, include the statement: "Invoice subject to reverse charge under Article 194 of Directive 2006/112/EC" and show VAT = 0 with a separate note.
- If Acme requires a separate VAT ID field for the buyer (for multi-entity invoicing), please confirm the tag name (BuyerVAT or BuyerTaxID) so we can include it in our generated XML/CSV.
- Preferred file types for automated ingestion: PDF + machine-readable XML (if you plan to ingest via EDI/Peppol).

I've attached a blank invoice template we use internally (redwood-invoice-template.xlsx) showing exact column headers. If Acme can confirm portal mappings, we can push the first batch of invoices through a sandbox run to validate.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Principal Accountant, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-invoice-template.xlsx (excel)

From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@acmeclinical.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Procurements AP <procurements@acmeclinical.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-09-03T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: New vendor: Redwood Inference - onboarding & PO requirements

Thanks, Soojin and Neha — this is helpful. A few clarifications from Acme AP team: 

- Portal mapping: BuyerPO is the field name in our vendor portal; BuyerVAT is supported as a separate numeric field.
- Reverse-charge: we'll accept the wording Neha provided; we'll notate the vendor record accordingly.
- Vendor ID: once the record is created you'll receive a system ID (we'll email it).
- EDI: we are piloting Peppol later this quarter; for now we'll accept PDF uploads to the portal.

Attached is the filled onboarding packet (we pre-populated a few fields). Please confirm the legal name and bank details are unchanged. Also, can Redwood accept net45 and confirm invoice due date on the invoice body as an explicit field? We use that to trigger payment-run schedules.

Attachment: acme_vendor_onboarding_packet_filled.xlsx

—Oliver
attachments: acme_vendor_onboarding_packet_filled.xlsx (excel)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@acmeclinical.com>, Procurements AP <procurements@acmeclinical.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-09-04T17:45:00Z
Subject: Re: New vendor: Redwood Inference - onboarding & PO requirements 

Thanks, team — confirming next steps and checklist so there's no ambiguity on either side.

Redwood confirmations:
- Legal name for vendor record: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (as provided) — please use exact spelling and punctuation.
- Bank/remit details: IBAN and SWIFT in attached onboarding form and sample invoice are current.
- VAT: we provided our VAT registration pdf; include the reverse-charge statement where Acme's AP flags it.
- Payment terms: Net45 accepted for onboarding; Redwood is open to early-pay program discussion after first two invoice cycles.

Acme requested deliverables for vendor creation:
1) Completed onboarding packet (received) — Acme to confirm vendor ID.
2) Sample invoice that includes BuyerPO and invoice due date (attached).
3) Portal mapping confirmation: BuyerPO (required), BuyerVAT (optional), Remit fields (required).

Operational timeline: 
- Vendor record creation (Acme): target 48 hours from receipt.
- Redwood submits first invoice referencing Acme PO# once vendor ID is received.
- Payment run expected Net45 after invoice acceptance.

If you can send the vendor ID when available (or a hubspot record link), we'll kick the first invoice through and confirm the file passes your portal validation. Thank you — happy to jump on a short call if anything needs live walk-through.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-invoice-sample.xlsx (excel), redwood-vat-certificate.pdf (pdf)
